propositions: MCP 1.29.0 defines Settings before FastMCP under postponed annotations, leaving Settings.lifespan as an unresolved ForwardRef that is never rebuilt after FastMCP becomes available
pydantic-settings 2.15 detects the incomplete FieldInfo on first Settings construction and emits IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning, which aborts MCP startup when promoted to an error
Calling public Pydantic Settings.model_rebuild() after importing Settings and FastMCP resolves the annotation and prevents the warning on first server construction
rebar.mcp_server.build_server() must invoke Settings.model_rebuild() at its MCP import boundary before either stdio or HTTP FastMCP construction

A fresh-process test must verify build_server() succeeds with IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning promoted to error, requiring subprocess isolation because first construction auto-completes the process-global model
